storm/flood/fire/outage-related food distribution cancellation or suspension

coverage_notes.source_priority: fresh local news, official agency/provider notices, direct source pages
observations: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified within the bounded hourly window.

Fresh West Maui brush-fire reporting documented evacuation, road closure, and contraflow near Olowalu General Store, but no structure impact and no evidence that the community's only/sole/last/full-service grocery access was lost.
Hurricane Nolo closure/cancellation reporting did not identify a new qualifying food-distribution, pantry/food-bank, grocery-access, SNAP, or WIC interruption in the window.
Older, duplicate, non-U.S., generic storm, donation-drive, and non-access-impact items were excluded.
degraded_reasons: One fresh Hurricane Nolo article returned HTTP 402 when opened; useful redundant Hawaii coverage remained available from local sources, so the run continued.
